title: All Flock Safety emails to SMPD (Jan 2020 – present)
summary:
Asked for every email any SMPD address received from @flocksafety.com or @mail.flocksafety.com since January 2020.

The scope was intended to surface vendor-originated correspondence that targeted policy or audit PRAs would not necessarily reach — for example camera-share-request notifications, configuration prompts, and feature notifications.
filed_because: Broad inbound-mail discovery covering Flock-originated correspondence to any SMPD inbox.
notes:
Withdrawn 2026-05-06.

The Department had on 2026-05-05 closed W012297-030826 into this corpus and on 2026-05-06 extended W012373-032026 and W012459-040226 under the same rolling-email-search framing. The withdrawal closed this request so it could no longer serve as the consolidation target for those substantive items. A narrower re-filing is reserved for after the substantive requests are resolved.

Records produced before withdrawal: Flock-generated camera-share-request emails and several marketing/webinar emails.
